title: Generic strict tower cone transport and successor comparison
statement: For an abelian category, levelwise mapping-cone evaluation, additive tensor mapping-cone comparison, and successor-compatible component isomorphisms assemble into strict tower isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 06YP, strict tensor-cone comparison and naturality of the total tensor cone

proof.text: Evaluate mapping cones levelwise and verify the two structure maps by the mapping-cone component formulas.
Use the existing natural signed tensor-cone isomorphism and its naturality for the transition square.
Construct the tower isomorphism from pointwise isomorphisms and successor naturality using NatTrans.ofOpSequence.

proof_origin.place: Generic strict tower and cone transport, written by P5, 2026-10-27

lemma coneComparison_fst
    {B : Type*} [Category B] [Abelian B]
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [Abelian D]
    {K L : CochainComplex B ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L) (E : B ⥤ D) [E.Additive] (r : ℤ) :
    ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso f E).hom.f r) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.fst ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f)).1.v
        r (r + 1) rfl = E.map ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.fst f).1.v r (r + 1) rfl)
